services.title: Protected services
services.description: Each service routes one hostname to an origin. Changes take effect immediately.
services.adminOnly: Only administrators can view and change protected services.
services.emptyDescription: Add a hostname and origin so OpenWAF can route and inspect its traffic.

services.editDescription: Saving replaces this service. The new configuration takes effect immediately.

services.upstreamDescription: HTTP or HTTPS origin, optionally with a port. No credentials, path, query, or fragment.
services.skipTlsDescription: Turn this on only when the HTTPS origin uses a certificate OpenWAF cannot verify.
services.tlsWarningDescription: Traffic to this origin will not be checked for a trusted certificate.

services.updatedDescription: The new configuration is already in effect.

services.deletedDescription: {hostname} is no longer routed. Its request logs are kept.
